title: Orthonormality of restricted Walsh vectors
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $A$ assign a sign vector in $\{−1,1\}^n$ to each element of $\Omega$, and suppose the multiset of vectors given by $A$ is $k$-wise independent. Let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ such that $|S\cup T|\le k$ for every $S,T\in\mathcal F$. For each $S\in\mathcal F$, form the vector indexed by $\omega\in\Omega$ whose entry is $|\Omega|^{-1/2}\prod_{i\in S} A(\omega)_i$; these vectors are orthonormal in the Euclidean space of real-valued functions on $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps $\Omega$ to sign vectors of length $n$
The multiset given by $A$ is $k$-wise independent
$\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
Every union $S\cup T$ for $S,T\in\mathcal F$ has cardinality at most $k$
